test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The price of fuel decreases by 40%, 15% and 45% in three successive months, but increases by 70% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off your answer to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take initial price = 100

After changes ⇒ 100 × 0.60 × 0.85 × 0.55 × 1.70

= 100 × 0.47685 = 47.685

Change = 47.685 − 100 = −52.315%

**∴ Answer = 52.32% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −40%, −15%, −45%, +70%

**Formula used:**

Net change = Product of multipliers

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let initial price = 100

⇒ After 1st: 100 × 0.60 = 60

⇒ After 2nd: 60 × 0.85 = 51

⇒ After 3rd: 51 × 0.55 = 28.05

⇒ After 4th: 28.05 × 1.70 = 47.685

⇒ Net change = 47.685 − 100 = −52.315

⇒ ≈ −52.32%

**∴ The correct answer is 52.32% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Use multipliers: (1 ± p/100) for each change

Multipliers

Decrease ⇒ multiply by (1 − p/100), Increase ⇒ (1 + p/100)

Important Tip

Successive changes are multiplicative, not additive

Rounding Rule

Round final percentage to two decimal places
